setting_action_row.name: row_motion
setting_action_row.label: Motion
setting_action_row.description: Jog layout, speeds and step distances

setting_dropdown_row.name: row_enclosure_style
setting_dropdown_row.label: Enclosure
setting_dropdown_row.description: Mark a printer you enclosed yourself

setting_toggle_row.name: row_allow_cold_extrude
setting_toggle_row.label: Allow cold load/unload
setting_toggle_row.description: Run filament load/unload even when the nozzle is cold (for macros that heat the nozzle themselves)
setting_toggle_row.subject: settings_allow_cold_extrude

setting_toggle_row.name: row_filament_auto_cooldown
setting_toggle_row.label: Cool nozzle after filament ops
setting_toggle_row.description: Turn the extruder heater off after a load or unload finishes
setting_toggle_row.subject: filament_auto_cooldown

setting_toggle_row.name: row_filament_auto_open_editor
setting_toggle_row.label: Edit filament on insert
setting_toggle_row.description: Open the slot editor when you load a new spool
setting_toggle_row.subject: filament_auto_open_editor

setting_toggle_row.name: row_tool_change_confirm
setting_toggle_row.label: Confirm tool changes
setting_toggle_row.description: Ask before switching to another tool
setting_toggle_row.subject: settings_tool_change_confirm

plugin_feature_toggle_row.name: row_power_loss_recovery
plugin_feature_toggle_row.label: Power-loss recovery
plugin_feature_toggle_row.description: Saves the print position about once a second so a print can resume after a power cut. On an SD card this adds wear.
plugin_feature_toggle_row.subject: plr_saving_enabled

setting_action_row.name: row_plr_mesh_include_add
setting_action_row.label: Resume reloads the saved bed mesh
setting_action_row.description: Add [include helix-plr/*.cfg] to printer.cfg, so a resume reloads the mesh the print started with

setting_action_row.name: row_plr_mesh_include_remove
setting_action_row.label: Resume reloads the saved bed mesh
setting_action_row.description: Remove HelixScreen's include lines from printer.cfg; a resume then uses the printer's default mesh profile

plugin_feature_toggle_row.name: row_print_hooks
plugin_feature_toggle_row.label: Apply start options to prints from other apps
plugin_feature_toggle_row.description: Sends your standing print options, such as unload at end, when a print starts from another app or the job queue.
plugin_feature_toggle_row.subject: plugin_feature_on_print_hooks

plugin_feature_toggle_row.name: row_pa_gauge
plugin_feature_toggle_row.label: Pressure advance from the nozzle sensor
plugin_feature_toggle_row.description: Installs a Klipper module that measures pressure advance with the nozzle's force sensor. It appears under Calibration after the next Klipper restart.
plugin_feature_toggle_row.subject: plugin_feature_on_pa_gauge

setting_action_row.name: row_macro_buttons
setting_action_row.label: Macro Buttons
setting_action_row.description: Configure quick buttons and standard macros
